name: Freshdesk
one_liner: Cloud customer support helpdesk with a JSON REST API v2 for tickets, contacts, companies and knowledge base.
auth_notes: Per-agent API key as Basic auth username (dummy password). The API reference also lists an 'OAuth 2.0 Scope' per endpoint (e.g. freshdesk.tickets.create), so OAuth exists; registration flow not confirmed. Freshworks MCP supports API key only.
access_notes: API key is available to any agent in any account incl. trials (trial default limit 50 calls/min). Rate limit is plan based: Growth 100, Pro 400, Enterprise 700 per minute. No plan is stated to lack API access.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve key via trial or paid account, broad documented REST API, per-plan rate limits. Sandbox only on Enterprise per pricing page.

evidence.quote: The Freshworks MCP server is exposed as a tenant-specific endpoint:
For all trial users, there is a default API limit of 50 calls/minute.

disputes.why: API reference lists 'OAuth 2.0 Scope' per endpoint.
Freshworks support article documents an official tenant-specific MCP endpoint, API-key auth.
Docs state trial accounts have API limit of 50 calls/min, so API usable in trial.
API reference lists well over 100 /api/v2 endpoint entries.
Support docs/search describe automation-rule webhooks counting against API quota; no dedicated webhooks API page fetched.
Pricing page lists Sandbox on Enterprise plan.
